context.transcript:
Hi Kate, would you be interested in helping me staff our table at the craft festival next Saturday?
Our store sponsors the events, so we get a booth in the sponsor section to distribute promotional materials.
Of course, what do I need to do?
We've been assigned to booth number three.
Here, it's on this map.
I'll be there at nine o'clock to set up.
Thanks, I can meet you there at nine o'clock.
Sounds good.
Be sure to pick up your ID badge at the entrance before you come to our booth.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，凯特，下周六你有没有兴趣帮我在工艺品节帮忙看摊？
我们店赞助这个活动，所以我们在赞助商区域会设一个展位分发宣传材料。
当然可以，我需要做什么呢？
我们被分配到三号展位。
看，就在这张地图上。
我九点到那里布置摊位。
谢谢，我九点在那里见你。
听起来不错。
记得在来我们展位之前，先去入口领取你的工牌。
